name: orbit-ranger
description: A step-by-step 3D game about designing and flying space missions: a wildfire-watching satellite, a Moon landing with its radio link to Earth, and a two-player launch, with 310 NASA 3D models. Built for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge.

scripts.test: node tests/run-tests.js && node tests/lunar-tests.js && node tests/learn-tests.js
scripts.test:browser: python3 tools/browser/check-levels.py && python3 tools/browser/check-moon.py && python3 tools/browser/check-coop.py && python3 tools/browser/check-phone.py
